summary: ONE Gas, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 4, 2026, announcing Q2 2026 financial results, raising 2026 adjusted earnings guidance to the upper half of prior ranges, and declaring a quarterly cash dividend of $0.68 per share, payable August 31, 2026, to shareholders of record August 17, 2026. The report is a routine earnings and dividend announcement, furnished under Items 2.02, 7.01, 8.01, and 9.01. It lacks any M&A, strategic review, tender, or capital-return event beyond the ordinary dividend. What to watch: no special-situation angle; focus remains on earnings guidance and dividend sustainability.
